title: A gateway ask_user escalation with no approval facility wired degrades to a fail-closed deny; the tool never executes
note: R05. unprofiled_echo has a registered descriptor but NO security profile, so the hardened gateway escalates it (ask_user). No checkpointer is wired, so there is nobody to ask: the confirm must degrade to a fail-closed deny (rule: consent-unavailable) and the execution count must stay zero. This is the documented consent ceiling, not a provenance-rule event.
